## Use Courier New in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Courier New for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Courier New', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## Where to get Courier New

Courier New ships with supported operating systems — there is nothing to download.

## About the Courier New coding font

A ubiquitous typewriter-style system monospace. Courier New is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Courier New ships with supported operating systems, so there is nothing to download before you try it, and the specimen above renders in the real face on those systems. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Courier New FAQ

### Is Courier New free?

Yes. Courier New is bundled with supported operating systems, so there is no separate purchase.

### Does Courier New support ligatures?

No. Courier New has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Courier New?

Courier New is already on supported systems — there is nothing to download.
